name: assetpanda/page-videos
title: AP Page Videos
description: Video gallery for /tutorials/: optional centred heading and intro over a dark theater panel — one large 16:9 player with the playing video's title and copy under it, and every other video as its own card in a deck beside it (the next one in front with its poster, the rest stacked behind it showing their titles; a swipe row under the player on tablets and phones). When the player scrolls into view the first video starts muted (YouTube IFrame API on youtube-nocookie.com, an Unmute pill turns the sound on); when a video ends the next card flies into the player and the old one goes to the back of the deck, looping from the last video to the first. Clicking a card plays it with sound and the cycle continues from it. No autoplay for reduced-motion or Save-Data visitors. Without JavaScript the first video is a poster linking to YouTube and every title is visible in the deck. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
